question: Which university faculty members' salaries are closest to the average salary for their respective ranks? Please provide the ranks, first names, last names, and salaries.university
sql:
WITH avg_salary AS (
  SELECT FacRank, AVG(FacSalary) AS avg_sal
  FROM university_faculty
  WHERE FacSalary IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY FacRank
),
with_diff AS (
  SELECT f.FacRank, f.FacFirstName, f.FacLastName, f.FacSalary,
         ABS(f.FacSalary - a.avg_sal) AS diff
  FROM university_faculty f
  JOIN avg_salary a ON f.FacRank = a.FacRank
  WHERE f.FacSalary IS NOT NULL
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT FacRank, FacFirstName, FacLastName, FacSalary,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY FacRank ORDER BY diff ASC, FacFirstName ASC) AS rn
  FROM with_diff
)
SELECT FacRank, FacFirstName, FacLastName, FacSalary
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY FacRank;
